WITH profile_avgs AS (
  SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
  GROUP BY o.weathprofile
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_profile_avg
  FROM profile_avgs
)
SELECT p.weathprofile,
       p.avg_bandusagepct,
       p.telescope_count,
       p.avg_bandusagepct - a.mean_profile_avg AS difference_from_mean
FROM profile_avgs AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS a
WHERE a.mean_profile_avg IS NOT NULL
